name: Keyboard lock indicators
author: gpt5.6-luna
description: Indicators for Caps Lock and Num Lock across connected keyboards

barWidget.description: Small indicators for Caps Lock and Num Lock. A lock active on any real keyboard is shown.

schema.label: Caps Lock color
schema.description: Color of the Caps Lock indicator. Leave "auto" to use the bar's active (urgent) color. Any CSS color, e.g. #ff4444.

schema.label: Num Lock color
schema.description: Color of the Num Lock indicator. Leave "auto" to use the bar's active (urgent) color. Any CSS color, e.g. #ff4444.
